ge0.sign_rule: +1/-1 only if both passes, the vote-mode order and both years agree, every input cites an archived sha256 and the audit is 'supported'; else 0

judgement.rule: judged when it runs at p < min(0.01, alpha/k1), strict; never withdrawn; the final Holm only adds passes; no Stage 2 in CB15

cb15_e.label: one-night case study (2026-11-03 US general election); the night is one cluster; L2 prospective, recorded books; no claim beyond that night

units.t_b_rule: mid whatever the spread; no ask -> 1, no bid -> 0; no exclusion at t_b

wallet.note: no CB15 job reads or stores a wallet field, a transaction hash (aggregated in memory and discarded) or the Data API side field

cb15_p.LABEL_P: selected on lifetime volume (C1 universe: Polymarket event volume >= 20k, Kalshi >= 5,000 contracts, >= 200 usable steps near resolution); L1 worn set; only P-rep can lead to Stage P

fetch.candles: [t_birth - 6 h, t_d + 25 h] and [t_L - 1 h, t_L + 25 h]
fetch.prices_history: fidelity 10 after t_birth only; points before counted
fetch.reach: complete iff a non-full page is reached (newest-first offset paging)
fetch.tx_windows: [t_birth, t_birth + 25 h] and [t_L - 2 h, t_L + 24 h 30 min]
fetch.volume: stored apart; opened only by the screen's tercile check

cb15_p.label: selected on lifetime volume (C1 universe: Polymarket event volume >= 20k, Kalshi >= 5,000 contracts, >= 200 usable steps near resolution); L1 worn set; only P-rep can lead to Stage P

population.c1_call: cb12_x.load_c1(root, expected=cb12_x.C1_EXPECTED) (pinned inputs and study source)
population.rule_booleans: Kalshi is_provisional / can_close_early (C1 universe rows, if present) vs Polymarket: no comparable Gamma booleans -> not applicable, reported

stage2.eligible: Kalshi-first (open_time <= listing - 24 h), no audit-conflict flag, Kalshi series category known and not Sports

first_print.late: detection after t_birth + 10 min -> late, excluded and counted

stage2.holm: one Stage-2 Holm over the triggered tests; early alpha/2; the Holm only adds passes
stage2.matcher: cross_venue.match_markets over Kalshi markets opened >= 24 h before the listing (mutual best against the new listings: declared), then the r1 audit_conflict rule (flag -> excluded, counted); source sha256 = CB12-X's pinned cross_venue.py

reads.books: Polymarket YES and NO /book, Kalshi orderbook (YES ask = 1 - best NO bid)

stage2.rep_checks: floor, small-G, top-5 event / week drops, halves, leave-one-quarter-out; P2-rep +1c per side; no bid at t_d + 24 h -> w*
stage2.rep_quote: two-sided, spread <= 10c, at the recorded reads
stage2.window: T15_P2_start = max(P freeze + 1 d, 2026-11-04T00:00Z); stop at >= 60 eligible births with their 24-h read (births, never results); cap 2027-04-30

bootstrap.small_g: G>=30 CR1; 15<=G<30 CR2 t(G-1) + Webb wild; G<15 the way leaves the max and its leave-one-cluster-out sign rule binds (CB10 2.3, A-C1)

holm.stage2_rule: checks_ok and (p < alpha/2 early or the final Stage-2 Holm rejects)

key_rule.E: calendar disjointness; keys as binding robustness (any source drops)
key_rule.P: drop a unit if any key has a source other than C1 (a C1-only key is kept)
key_rule.sources: rebuilt from readable sources; unattributed inherited ids are never C1-only

common.stop_rule: 3 CPU-hours per family; a job failing twice for the same non-transient reason stops; no re-screen of a failed CB15 test

smoke.consequence: a failed criterion makes the dependent family not testable (source), counted once; no rule is re-fitted
smoke.design: family modules contribute SMOKE_NEEDS / smoke_offline / smoke_online; the orchestrator is family-agnostic
